title: Cashmere Museum and Pioneer Village

services.name: Tours
services.desc: The Museum requires that all tour groups of children 3rd grade and under be accompanied by a docent. Each group is limited to 20 guests per

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Photo shoots for bridal parties, engagements, or high school yearbooks can be held in the Pioneer Village, as well as wedding ceremonies. Receptions, birthday parties, and reunions can be held in the Rotary Pavilion in the Chief John Harmelt Park on the Museum’s grounds. Absolutely NO alcohol consumption or smoking is allowed in the Pioneer Village or on Museum grounds. The Cashmere Museum & Pioneer Village is graciously supported by the Icicle Fund. With your premium membership, you also become part of the North American Reciprocal Museum

services.name: Cabin Clean Up
services.desc: As we get ready for our season finale the Pioneer Village Fest on October 3rd, we gather to spruce up the village. This day brings together the fleet of volunteers who help us keep the village in tip-top shape. We share the cleaning tasks and do a checkup on all of the nuts and bolts in the village. Do you think you make the best pie in town? Enter your apple or pear pie on October 3rd for a chance to win a prize and bragging rights! Come on down and celebrate the Pioneer Village at the Cashmere Museum. We will have food, live music, entertainment, artisan vendors, and live demonstrations of old-world skills. Our village buildings will be open for exploration, visitors can sip sarsaparilla
